name: Franzlhof
beschreibung: The Franzlhof in Söll lies at the foot of the Wilden Kaiser in Tirol. The family-run hotel offers alpine-style accommodation and a wellness area with sauna, steam bath and swimming pool. In winter, the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental is easily reached via the Söller Seilbahn. In summer, the surrounding peaks such as the Hohe Salve serve as hiking destinations. At the hotel, rental bikes are available for excursions into the Brixental. The cuisine focuses mainly on regional products from the Sölllandl. The quiet location on the edge of town combines a nature stay with proximity to the center of Söll.
